items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: I guess he's out of Angola now, wherever they put him, Paris Cruiser.

ctx.x: Yeah, he made the trambone. Then he comes to me to sell the trambone, and that's where he got tricked. Put him right in the trick bag, right over here in the firehouse.
I guess he's out of Angola now, wherever they put him, Paris Cruiser.
He's out. He sees me, man, he hits him. He's out now. Yeah.
